reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in his DM (DGBRAIN0002) and did not set up the 09:00 digest.

Scheduled jobs created from this session are local-only and their output isn't delivered back to a chat, so a recurring DM from me wouldn't reliably reach him. The reply tells him that and offers an on-demand digest of #coastal-team instead. Kwame is a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it for him when he asks.

If a recurring digest is required, it needs a job delivered to a messaging platform connected to the gateway, which I can't set up from this CLI session.
